So, everyone must select a budget-friendly means for their use. Every device has its features and benefits. You will learn about Google Data and Power BI in this blog. After reading the blog, you have the clarity of both tools. This information lets you decide which tool is better for you. Google Data Studio VS Power BI Here are the following points for power bi vs data studio: Price: If we are discussing the price of both tools, then the google data studio is free of cost for all users. If you want to use google data studio, you must create an account on google; that is mandatory. The power bi works in two versions: the first is free for all and has limited functionalities, and the other is the paid version, which has many features and functionalities. In the paid version, you have the option for live dashboards and reports and share yours with the organization. You can access advanced AI and optimize data access and control at an enterprise level. Installation: Power BI is offered in three different versions: Power BI Desktop, Power BI Pro, and Power BI Premium. The free version of power bi can install on the desktop. Power pro and power premium is the paid version. Google Data Studio is entirely hosted in the cloud. If you want to use data studio, you should have a Google account to sign in to the service. There’s no desktop application. Data types source: Power bi enables the integration of more than 100 sources of data. It supports PDF, JSON, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, and many more. Features: Power BI is for data analysts at all levels, from essential to expert. For manipulating data, it has a good amount of tools. You may also access a variety of data visualization components, such as charts, tables, graphs, etc. Since Data Studio is primarily a data visualization program, it has fewer functionalities. However, its robust in-memory BI engine is especially useful for massive data sets and removes any data visualization delays. Sharing data: Reports sharing is difficult in the power bi. A report cannot be transferred straight from the desktop app. The information must be published in the Power BI service. If you want to share the report or dashboard, you can use the mobile app to share it. But the Data Studio makes it simple to share an account, but you have an email address or shareable public link. Data Studio is a free product provided by Google. Online community: The Microsoft Power BI Community is a vast knowledge resource where you can learn about Power BI and have your questions answered. This platform has several parts with content, like Themes Gallery, Data Stories Gallery, Custom Visuals Ideas, Developer, etc. Additionally, Data Studio offers a robust community platform. You may access several external visualization widgets through the tools. Pros of Google Data Studio Regular Updates: It updates monthly and adds new features to improve its functionality. Flexible & Effective: Many marketers feel confident writing reports using the default interface of Google Analytics. Customers had to go through several pages to make reports on this platform and choose from various filters. Easy sharing: It works as the other tool of google, like google drive. You can give access to the other person for editing or viewing and save it as in PDF. The Data Studio dashboard refreshes in real-time as a filtering feature. The user has advanced filtering for viewing the data. Users may change the date range with the touch of a button. Final Words The ability to develop and track reports with the aid of Google Data Studio makes life easier for users in the agency environment. This is an excellent tool for those who are not data professionals. Additionally, unless you use community connections, it is free. On the other side, Consider Power BI if you have a more extensive range of data sources and want a BI solution with excellent data transformation capabilities and customization possibilities and you don’t mind paying.
